pages.text: A Tobacco Crate is lossless bulk packaging for exactly $(item)9$() units. Fill every slot of a 3×3 crafting grid with the $(thing)same registry item$(). The nine items may carry different quality, cure, cut, age, flavor, or other NBT/components.

pages.title: Raw vs Cured Crates
pages.text: Raw leaves create a green $(thing)Raw <Variety> Tobacco Crate$(). Cured leaves and single-variety loose tobacco create the normal cured-color crate for that variety. Blended Tobacco creates a Blended Tobacco Crate.

pages.title: Lossless Contents
pages.text: The crate stores each of the nine inputs separately. Breaking a filled crate in Survival spills those exact nine units back out; it does not average or flatten their metadata. Creative breaking suppresses the stored drops.

pages.title: Not a Live Inventory
pages.text: Crates are packaged storage blocks, not nine-slot machines. Hoppers, funnels, and Mechanical Arms do not insert/extract individual contents from a placed crate. Break the crate to unpack it.
